title: Attention Is All You Need: Core Argument Plan
subtitle: From Sequential Constraints to Parallel Self-Attention Mechanisms

nodes.title: Limitations of Sequential Models
nodes.purpose: Define the core problem: RNNs/CNNs suffer from sequential computation constraints and difficulty learning long-range dependencies due to path length.

nodes.title: Transformer Architecture Overview
nodes.purpose: Describe the novel encoder-decoder structure composed entirely of attention mechanisms and feed-forward layers, discarding recurrence and convolution.

nodes.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention Mechanism
nodes.purpose: Explain the mathematical formulation of the attention function, including the scaling factor $1/\\\sqrt{d_k}$ to prevent vanishing gradients in softmax.

nodes.title: Multi-Head Attention Strategy
nodes.purpose: Detail the mechanism of projecting queries, keys, and values into multiple subspaces ($h=8$) to jointly attend to information from different representation positions.

nodes.title: Positional Encoding Injection
nodes.purpose: Clarify how order information is injected using sine/cosine functions since the model lacks inherent sequential processing, enabling relative position learning.

nodes.title: Computational Complexity & Path Length
nodes.purpose: Present the theoretical advantage: O(1) maximum path length and parallelizability compared to O(n) for RNNs, supported by Table 1 analysis.

nodes.title: Training Configuration & Optimization
nodes.purpose: Outline key training hyperparameters: Adam optimizer, learning rate schedule with warmup, residual dropout, and label smoothing.

nodes.title: Machine Translation State-of-the-Art
nodes.purpose: Verify the primary claim: achieving new SOTA BLEU scores on WMT 2014 En-De (28.4) and En-Fr (41.8) with significantly reduced training costs.

nodes.title: Component Ablation & Variations
nodes.purpose: Analyze the impact of specific design choices (number of heads, key dimensions, positional encoding types) via Table 3 experiments.

nodes.title: Generalization to Constituency Parsing
nodes.purpose: Demonstrate model versatility by applying Transformer to English constituency parsing tasks with limited and semi-supervised data.

coverage_notes: The argument flows logically from identifying the bottleneck of sequential models (RNNs) to proposing a purely attention-based solution.
Core mathematical definitions (Scaled Dot-Product, Multi-Head projection matrices) are explicitly covered in nodes 3 and 4.
Empirical evidence is structured by primary task performance (Translation) followed by secondary validation (Parsing) and internal component analysis (Ablation).
Visual evidence of attention heads learning syntactic/semantic structures (Figures 3-5) supports the 'Why Self-Attention' argument but is qualitative.
